name: Shortened: HOOK 1
speech: You can't see it, but your mattress could be hiding a colony of dust mites, deep in the
foam where washing sprays and vacuums never reach.
The plant-derived lure draws them up and out.
The adhesive locks them on the card, and your foam light shows you everything.
Every other thing I tried asked me to believe it was working, even when I felt it wasn't.
If you have dust mites or you wake up blocked and tired, you already know you need this.
Tap below and see what comes out of yours.
